name: Harrowgate Ironbacks
description: A Tier 2-3 sponsored combat football club fielded by HelixCorp's regional entertainment division, the Ironbacks play out of Harrowgate District's Crucible Arena — a repurposed industrial dock retrofitted with impact-dampening field panels. Known for their signature defensive line, four of whom carry military-grade skeletal reinforcement, they reached the IRONWALL LEAGUE finals in 2193 before a controversial augmentation audit disqualified their star flanker, Obinna Czajkowski-Reyes, over an undisclosed chrome variance.
story_hooks: A journalist investigating the 2193 audit receives an anonymous package containing the original variance readings — and someone wants it back.
Czajkowski-Reyes, now running a gray-market augmentation shop on the Shelf, is approached to play again under a false identity for an underground circuit.
A rookie Ironbacks player discovers their newly installed chrome was sourced from an illegal trial batch and must decide whether to report it before the season opener.
